{{Quote|These guys are just a pirate gang. They have refused an offer to work for Valarian, and Jabba considers them to be amateurs. They have minor connections with Black Sun, but that organization won't lift a finger if these guys need help.|[[Sarlis Beni]], to a spy|<ref name="SWG:PtB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Spy|Paying the Bills|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
A gang of '''pirates''' led by [[Eyan McDermitt]] operated on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I have a contract from an influential member of the Incom corporation. It seems one of their courier ships was hijacked by some pirates. The pirates were only after general cargo, but they ended up getting much more.|Sarlis Beni, to a spy|<ref name="SWG:CE" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the gang was based in [[Mos Taike/Legends|Mos Taike]], on the planet Tatooine, and was ruled by Eyan McDermitt.<ref name="SWG:CE" /> Althoug the gang had ties with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], it was largely considered with disdain by other criminal organization, such as [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's criminal empire]]. Nevertheless, the pirates had refused to work for the [[Valarian Syndicate]].<ref name="SWG:PtB" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the gang hijacked a courier ship belonging to the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. The pirates were only after general cargo but they also stole an encrypted [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] with sensitive information.<ref name="SWG:PtB" /> One of the pirates, [[Oniruko]], attempted to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] but she was fatally injured by the storage device's protection system. Since he did not succeed in obtaining the data, Eyan McDermitt later accepted to sell the datapad to an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] named [[Jubai Laetlii]]. Meanwhile, an individual by the name [[Sarlis Beni]] was contacted by Incom Corporation to retrieve the datapad. Beni localized the pirate gang and dispatched a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] to recover the storage data. The spy killed four members of the gang and confronted McDermitt. The pirate leader was forced to reveal he had sold the datapad to Jubai Laetlii. The spy then left the pirates and departed to the [[Imperial Oasis]] to find Laetlii. The datapad was eventually returned to Incom Corporation.<ref name="SWG:CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pirates appeared in [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The pirates were added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
